text: 当地时间8月1日，美国国务院向身处中东地区的美国公民发出广泛安全警告，建议他们“考虑离开当地，或做好在局势升级时迅速撤离的准备”。据此前消息，美国官员透露，华盛顿正考虑最快于本周末对伊朗发动新一轮军事打击。与此同时，伊朗方面也称，将进一步打击那些允许美军驻扎军事基地的国家。美国国务院再次提醒，身处中东地区的人员应保持谨慎并提高警惕，同时做好应对航班取消、临时关闭领空以及其他旅行中断的准备。公告还强调，计划前往中东地区的美国公民应认真重新考虑自己的出行计划。
text_en: On August 1 local time, the U.S. State Department issued a broad security alert to American citizens in the Middle East, advising them to "consider leaving the area, or be prepared to evacuate quickly if the situation escalates." U.S. officials have said Washington is weighing a new round of military strikes on Iran as early as this weekend. Meanwhile, Iran has also said it will further strike countries that allow U.S. troops to be stationed at military bases on their soil. The State Department again reminded people in the Middle East to remain cautious and vigilant, while preparing for flight cancellations, temporary airspace closures, and other travel disruptions. The advisory also stressed that American citizens planning to travel to the Middle East should seriously reconsider their travel plans.
